hooks.name: Filipino Language Check
hooks.description: Validates that user-facing strings default to Filipino (KlimaGuard is Filipino-first).

action.prompt:
A component or page file was just saved. Validate that user-facing text defaults to Filipino:

1. Scan the saved file for hardcoded user-facing strings (JSX text, placeholders, aria-labels, button labels, titles).
2. Flag any strings in English only that have no Filipino equivalent.
3. Suggest Filipino translations for each flagged string.
4. IGNORE: CSS classes, variable names, API URLs, console messages.
5. IGNORE: proper nouns (PAGASA, NDRRMC, Open-Meteo, KlimaGuard).

End your report with exactly one of:
- "✅ All strings Filipino-ready"
- "⚠️ N strings need translation" (replace N with the count), followed by the flagged strings and suggested translations.
